letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">有RAG的LLM：用户查询 -&gt; 问题向量化 -&gt; （已向量化的）知识库检索（计算相似度、排序等）-&gt; 大模型分析（用户查询+检索文本）</span></section></li></ul><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">中间多了向量化和知识库检索的过程，那为什么要增加这个步骤呢，就要看看LLM本身有哪些限制。</span></section><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf=""><br></span></section><section style="display: flex; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><section style="display: flex; align-items: flex-start"><section mpa-none-content="t" style="height: 28px; margin-right: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center"><span style="width: 9px; height: 9px; background: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); border-radius: 50%" mpa-none-content="t"></span><span style="width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); border-radius: 50%; margin-left: -4px" mpa-none-content="t"></span></section><section style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); line-height: 28px; flex: 1 1 0; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">2、LLM的缺陷&amp;RAG的作用：</span></section></section></section><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">1、数据非实时，他所学到的是截止到模型训练完成那一刻的知识，不具备知识更新能力</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">RAG：可以检索最新的信息，快速生成相关文本，避免重新训练带来的时间成本和算力成本</span></section></li></ul><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">2、不具备私有领域的知识</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">RAG：可以通过配置私有知识库，同时避免了隐私数据进行模型训练的安全风险</span></section></li></ul><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">3、存在幻觉，看似合理实际上是错误的答案</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">RAG：通过检索信息，提高生成文本的准确性，降低幻觉，可以追溯来源，提高可解释性</span></section></li></ul><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">4、长文本推理限制，上下文能力存在上限，且推理成本高，也容易出现记忆混乱</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><section><span leaf="">RAG：解决了上下文token量的限制，信息可追溯，推理消耗的token大大降低</span></section><section><span leaf=""><br></span></section></section></li></ul><section style="display: flex; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><section style="display: flex; align-items: flex-start"><section mpa-none-content="t" style="height: 28px; margin-right: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center"><span style="width: 9px; height: 9px; background: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); border-radius: 50%" mpa-none-content="t"></span><span style="width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); border-radius: 50%; margin-left: -4px" mpa-none-content="t"></span></section><section style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); line-height: 28px; flex: 1 1 0; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">3、RAG三大核心如何理解？</span></section></section></section><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">①&nbsp;</span><span leaf="" style="font-weight: bold">知识库</span><span leaf="">：存数据的容器，把原始数据变成 “能快速检索、语义完整” 的形式，这个过程需要“ 清洗→分块→向量化→建索引 ”这一系列处理，存储方式也各式各样，比如前面我们通过Dify搭建的知识库，他是通过PostgreSQL配合pgvector插件来实现向量检索的能力，当然，纯向量数据库是目前主流的载体，例如Chroma、Milvus等等。这块内容我们下次细讲。</span></section><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">②&nbsp;</span><span leaf="" style="font-weight: bold">大模型</span><span leaf="">：底层逻辑就是通过计算所有下一个token的概率，再根据一些规则去筛选，主要依赖这三个参数就可以控制大模型输出的效果：</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf=""><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">温度：&nbsp;</span>temperature=1时代表保持原状；temperature&lt;1时，概率会被放大，概率高的token会高的更明显，相反剩余的概率就会更低；temperature&gt;1时，温度越大，概率值会越平均。</span></section></li></ul><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf=""><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">Top-K：</span>&nbsp;正整数，表示在模型计算在top k的范围里随机取值作为输出，K值越大，那么随机性就越高，K值越小，那相对越稳健。</span></section></li></ul><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf=""><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">Top-p：</span>&nbsp;百分比，表示计算得出的概率在p值以上的范围内去随机选择，p值越大，结果越稳定，p值越小，结果越随机，相对Top-K是一个绝对范围，而Top-p是个相对范围。</span></section></li></ul><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">③&nbsp;</span><span leaf="" style="font-weight: bold"><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">检索</span></span><span leaf=""><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">：</span>从知识库中找到与问题最相关的信息，包括“查询-&gt;召回-&gt;排序-&gt;过滤”，下面就重点讲解下向量检索的过程。</span></section><section style="margin-bottom: 16px; margin-top: 16px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1)"><span leaf=""><br></span></section><section style="margin-bottom: 16px; margin-top: 16px; margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">Embedding 是 RAG 的 底层技术底座：</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; width: fit-content" class="list-paddingleft-1"><li><section style="margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">Embedding（向量嵌入）：把文本变成数字向量，让机器能 “算相似度”。</span></section></li></ul><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; color: rgba(37, 37, 37, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">Embedding是将数据对象映射到固定大小的连续一维数字数组的技术。向量空间通常具有几百到几千的维度，每个维度代表某个语义特征或属性。</span></section><section style="margin-bottom: 16px; margin-top: 16px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1)"><span leaf=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1279674/202608/1279674-20260813071052601-838082426.png" alt=""><img class="rich_pages wxw-img"><img class="rich_pages wxw-img"><img class="rich_pages wxw-img"></span></section><section style="font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgba(72, 72, 72, 1); margin-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">① 离线构建知识库（必须用 Embedding）</span></section><ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">文档 → 分块（chunk）</span></section></li></ul><ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 1.2em; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 378px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># max_length=30：限制每个文本最多 30 个 token（截断过长文本）</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 280px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># return_tensors="pt"：返回 PyTorch 张量格式</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">batch_tokens = tokenizer(</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">30</span></span><span leaf="">,&nbsp;</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; padding=</span><span style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); &nbsp; truncation=</span><span style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 26px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">True</span></span><span leaf="">,&nbsp;</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; return_tensors=</span><span style="color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 26px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"pt"</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 132px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"第一句话的分词结果："</span></span><span leaf="">, token)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 298px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># 获取第一句话的 token id（模型可识别的数字编码）</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">token_id = batch_tokens.input_ids[</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">0</span></span><span leaf="">]</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">print(</span><span style="color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 416px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># ===================== 5. 模型推理生成嵌入 =====================</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 406px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># 将分词后的张量传入模型，获取模型输出（包含隐藏层状态、池化输出等）</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 418px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># **batch_tokens：自动解包 input_ids/attention_mask 等参数传入模型</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">outputs = model(**batch_tokens)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 416px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># ===================== 6. 生成句子嵌入向量 =====================</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 192px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># 提取 CLS token 作为句子嵌入：</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 486px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># outputs.last_hidden_state[:,0]：取每个句子的第一个 token（CLS token）的向量</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 430px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># F.normalize(..., p=2, dim=1)：L2 归一化（必须！否则相似度计算失真）</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">embeddings = F.normalize(outputs.last_hidden_state[:,&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">0</span></span><span leaf="">], p=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">2</span></span><span leaf="">, dim=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">1</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 416px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># ===================== 7. 计算并输出相似度 =====================</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(153, 153, 136, 1); &nbsp; similarity = cos_sim(embeddings[</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">0</span></span><span leaf="">], embeddings[i])</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; margin-top: 16px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><section style="width: 100%"><section mpa-none-content="t" style="width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 1px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(132, 155, 193, 1); margin: 0 0 0 7px" mpa-none-content="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section></section><section style="background: rgba(224, 231, 249, 1); width: 100%"><section style="text-align: left; background: rgba(245, 248, 255, 1); width: 100%; transform: translate(-3px, -3px); padding: 14px 12px 13px"><section style="font-size: 15px; color: rgba(42, 42, 42, 1); line-height: 28px; font-family: Optima-Regular, PingFangTC-light"><span leaf="">CLS：分类token，预留汇总整句话含义的位置，SEP：句子结束标识，PAD：根据最长token数补位标识。</span></section></section></section></section></section><section style="font-size: 15px;
